description: The Frankfurt office monitoring research team publishes indoor, outdoor, energy and occupant-behaviour observations from a naturally ventilated office building in Germany. The OSF project describes 116 measurement points across 16 small offices, with operable windows and manually or automatically controlled shading. It lists a CSV codebook and separate files for occupancy, temperatures, window states and other sensors. Access is public and free under CC0. The historical, multi-year observations can calibrate ventilation and occupant-control simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that the article reports 17 offices while the repository reports 16, so the exact monitored room set needs checking against the codebook. The repository overview does not state exact coverage dates. Sensor reliability varies across the campaign, and no individual sensor series was downloaded.
